issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The bit-frequency filter (keep fingerprint bits that are set in at least 3 training molecules) is computed from Xtr only. Xte gets the same mask, so test inputs and labels are not used.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The mask keeps all non-fingerprint columns, as long as the first N_BITS columns are the Morgan bits, which the incumbent's featurize layout implies. Train and test are indexed the same way.

My recomputed z is about -0.89 to -0.91, against a reported -0.887. I used noise sd 0.0037 with 1 candidate run and 2 incumbent runs, so se = 0.0037*sqrt(1+1/2) ≈ 0.00453. The gap is because the inputs are rounded to 4 decimals: the stated difference of 0.0041 gives -0.905, and the reported -0.887 fits a true difference of about 0.0040. The candidate is worse (0.3696 vs 0.3655) but within noise. The provisional reject is reasonable: the change adds code and does not improve the loss.
